description: This PHP class `EmbeddedURLForDailymotion` extends `AbstractBuzzVideoURL` and is responsible for processing, validating, and converting Dailymotion URLs into embedded URL formats. It contains regex patterns for Dailymotion URLs and methods to extract or generate embed URLs from input URLs.

classes.name: EmbeddedURLForDailymotion
classes.description: A class that derives from AbstractBuzzVideoURL used to handle Dailymotion video URLs, providing functionality to retrieve embedded URLs based on regex parsing and URL validation.

methods.name: getEmbeddedURL
methods.description: Returns the embedded URL for Dailymotion videos if the URL matches predefined patterns; throws an exception if the URL is invalid or doesn't match expected patterns.
